query:
Someone in the group mentioned that Dev had recently helped them set up a piece of tech — something that had been misbehaving since Tuesday. Who was that person?

Options:
A. Sandra
B. Claire
C. Marcus
D. Yuki
context:
[1] (about=Dev, episodic, t10 @2025-11-23T10:45:00) helped with the van saturday morning. he was packed already. had a coffee and he was gone in 90 minutes
[2] (about=Yuki, episodic, t10 @2025-11-23T10:39:00) Glad he got there OK. Honestly I didn't realise how much I'd notice him being gone. He helped me carry my bike up the stairs last week and didn't make anything of it -- just did it. I keep thinking about that for some reason.
[3] (about=Claire, episodic, t10 @2025-11-23T10:41:00) That is so Marcus.
[4] (about=Sandra, episodic, t10 @2025-11-23T10:48:00) That sounds about right for Marcus. I'm glad you were there, Dev. -- Sandra
[5] (about=Sandra, episodic, t12 @2025-11-30T11:52:00) That is very thoughtful, Dev. I appreciate it. Let Claire and Yuki try the friendly approach first and then if needed we have a technical option. -- Sandra
[6] (about=Yuki, episodic, t13 @2025-12-07T10:50:00) Quick update from Tuesday: Claire and I knocked on number 11. He's called Ryan, about 25, moved from Manchester. Very apologetic when we mentioned the music. I think he genuinely hadn't realised. Also he's really nice 🙂
[7] (about=Yuki, episodic, t12 @2025-11-30T11:27:00) Yes I heard that too. Bass through the wall at 12:30. Is that a new person in there?
[8] (about=Claire, episodic, t0 @2025-10-12T10:17:00) Did they update the app at least? Or do we just have to hope we all saw Sandra's message? 😑
[9] (about=Claire, episodic, t6 @2025-11-02T12:28:00) Till about half six! Sandra opened a bottle and then Marcus found the one remaining chair that hadn't got damp and we just... kept going.
[10] (about=Sandra, episodic, t6 @2025-11-02T12:33:00) The quiche went too. I should have made two. Also Yuki I wanted to say -- I know I left a note on your door last month about the bins going out on the wrong day, but I hope you know that was just meant helpfully and not as a reprimand. You can always ask me if you're not sure what goes where. -- Sandra
agent_answer: There is no information available in the conversation to answer this question.

query:
When the group was settling on a low-key format for the BBQ, someone said 'Honestly that sounds perfect. Low key is the right call.' Who said that?

Options:
A. Yuki
B. Sandra
C. Dev
D. Claire
context:
[1] (about=Claire, episodic, t2 @2025-10-19T11:42:00) Honestly that sounds perfect. Low key is the right call.
[2] (about=Sandra, episodic, t4 @2025-10-26T11:00:00) Just a quick note: I was thinking about what Yuki said last week about keeping things low-key, and I have to agree that is the right approach. We get ourselves into trouble when we over-organise. The summer party last year had a running order and it felt like a work meeting by the end. -- Sandra
[3] (about=Yuki, episodic, t14 @2025-12-07T11:31:00) The BBQ. No question.
[4] (about=Sandra, episodic, t12 @2025-11-30T12:04:00) They should have sent it to all residents, not just owners. I'll mention it at the next meeting. In the meantime I'll put your vote down alongside mine if you tell me your preference. -- Sandra
[5] (about=Sandra, episodic, t14 @2025-12-07T11:32:00) The BBQ, and Marcus's goodbye dinner. Both. I do not want to choose. -- Sandra
[6] (about=Sandra, episodic, t14 @2025-12-07T10:55:00) Just a quick note: this is exactly the right outcome. A note and a knock beats a formal complaint every single time. I'm very pleased. -- Sandra
[7] (about=Yuki, episodic, t13 @2025-12-07T10:50:00) Quick update from Tuesday: Claire and I knocked on number 11. He's called Ryan, about 25, moved from Manchester. Very apologetic when we mentioned the music. I think he genuinely hadn't realised. Also he's really nice 🙂
[8] (about=Yuki, episodic, t2 @2025-10-19T11:28:00) Slightly different topic but -- what if we did something together before winter properly sets in? Like a street thing. BBQ or just drinks outside. I could bring food, it doesn't have to be a big production 🙂
[9] (about=Sandra, episodic, t8 @2025-11-16T11:26:00) I will make a proper dinner if you will all come to mine. A real meal, not just a glass and a handful of crisps. Marcus deserves a proper send-off. -- Sandra
[10] (about=Sandra, episodic, t12 @2025-11-30T11:52:00) That is very thoughtful, Dev. I appreciate it. Let Claire and Yuki try the friendly approach first and then if needed we have a technical option. -- Sandra
